issues.description: Resource IDs are interpolated into URL paths without percent-encoding, so slashes, query strings, or fragments can alter the requested endpoint.
The retry loop handles only HTTP responses; timeouts and transport failures are not retried or wrapped in typed SDK errors.
batch_create eagerly materializes the entire iterable, contradicting the documented any-number/any-iterable behavior and risking high memory use.
Paginated list methods silently skip malformed items instead of raising schema errors, which can hide API corruption or data loss.
batch_create silently drops malformed result entries and can return fewer results than requested without surfacing an error.
Literal-backed fields such as status, state, batch status, and verdict are not runtime-validated, so invalid API states enter typed models.
Frozen dataclasses expose mutable dict fields and return those dicts from to_dict, allowing model state to mutate after construction.
HTTP 207 is treated as success for every endpoint instead of only the batch endpoint, which can bypass normal error handling.
max_attempts is not validated, so zero or negative values produce a misleading runtime failure instead of a configuration error.
The package advertises a typed client but does not ship a py.typed marker, so installed users may not get PEP 561 type information.
